title: How Big Should A Rabbit's Cage Be?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: How Big Should A Rabbit’s Cage Be?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage and article pages.
-->

<section class="rccage-page alignfull" id="rabbit-cage-size">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rccage-page,
    .rccage-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rccage-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rccage-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    .rccage-page a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 10px; }

    .rccage-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rccage-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rccage-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rccage-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rccage-btns { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; align-items: center; margin-top: 30px; }

    .rccage-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rccage-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
    .rccage-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage)); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26); }
    .rccage-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); color: var(--rc-moss); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10); }

    .rccage-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rccage-hero-image-wrap { width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fff9ef; overflow: hidden; }
    .rccage-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rccage-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.70), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.30) 48%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.06)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rccage-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rccageFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rccage-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 760px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rccage-hero-title-overlay .rccage-pill { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }

    .rccage-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rccage-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rccage-hero-content { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr; gap: 34px; align-items: center; padding-top: 44px; }
    .rccage-breadcrumb { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 18px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 800; }
    .rccage-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rccage-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rccage-hero-subtitle { max-width: 720px; margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem); }

    .rccage-hero-card,
    .rccage-side-card,
    .rccage-panel,
    .rccage-size-card,
    .rccage-step,
    .rccage-benefit,
    .rccage-item-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rccage-hero-card { padding: 28px; border-radius: 38px; box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }
    .rccage-hero-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.18; }
    .rccage-hero-card ul { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rccage-hero-card li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 700; }
    .rccage-hero-card li::before { content: "✓"; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 900; }

    .rccage-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }
    .rccage-quickbar-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }
    .rccage-quick { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 96px; padding: 18px; border-radius: 24px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb); transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; }
    .rccage-quick:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14); }
    .rccage-quick-icon { width: 62px; height: 62px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 2.35rem; line-height: 1; }
    .rccage-quick strong { display: block; color: var(--rc-moss); line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.02rem; }
    .rccage-quick span span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.35; }

    .rccage-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }
    .rccage-section-header { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto 32px; text-align: center; }

    .rccage-section h2,
    .rccage-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rccage-section-header p { margin: 0 auto; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.08rem; max-width: 680px; }
    .rccage-article-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px; gap: 28px; align-items: start; }
    .rccage-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rccage-panel { position: relative; padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px); border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); overflow: hidden; }
    .rccage-panel::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 190px; height: 190px; right: -82px; top: -92px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10); pointer-events: none; }
    .rccage-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rccage-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }
    .rccage-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rccage-panel p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.03rem; }
    .rccage-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rccage-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 22px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rccage-list li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr; gap: 12px; align-items: start; padding: 15px; border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10); color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 700; }
    .rccage-list li::before { content: "✓"; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 900; }

    .rccage-sidebar { position: sticky; top: 22px; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
    .rccage-side-card { padding: 22px; border-radius: 28px; }
    .rccage-side-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.18rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rccage-side-card ul { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rccage-side-card a { display: block; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff9ef; color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 850; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; }
    .rccage-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rccage-note { padding: 20px; border-radius: 24px; background: #ffffff; border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold); color: var(--rc-muted); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08); }
    .rccage-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rccage-size-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rccage-size-card { padding: 26px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; text-align: center; }
    .rccage-size-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); }
    .rccage-size-card b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 64px; height: 64px; margin: 0 auto 18px; border-radius: 24px; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-size: 1.7rem; }
    .rccage-size-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.3rem; }
    .rccage-size-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 750; }

    .rccage-table-wrap { margin-top: 24px; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 26px; box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10); }
    .rccage-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #ffffff; min-width: 520px; }
    .rccage-table th, .rccage-table td { padding: 18px 20px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12); }
    .rccage-table th { background: #fff9ef; color: var(--rc-moss); font-weight: 950; }
    .rccage-table td { color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 750; }
    .rccage-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }

    .rccage-warning { padding: 68px 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)); }
    .rccage-warning-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 28px; align-items: center; padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px); border-radius: 42px; background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); }
    .rccage-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }
    .rccage-warning-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.06rem; }
    .rccage-warning-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rccage-warning-list li { padding: 16px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--rc-danger-soft); color: #4a2823; font-weight: 850; text-align: center; }

    .rccage-image-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr; gap: 30px; align-items: center; }
    .rccage-image-card { position: relative; min-height: 430px; }
    .rccage-image-card img { position: absolute; object-fit: cover; display: block; border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); transition: transform 0.35s ease; }
    .rccage-image-card img:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important; }
    .rccage-img-main { width: 82%; height: 350px; left: 0; top: 20px; border-radius: 42px; transform: rotate(-2deg); }
    .rccage-img-small { width: 54%; height: 230px; right: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 34px; transform: rotate(4deg); background: #fff9ef; }

    .rccage-setup { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)); }
    .rccage-items-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rccage-item-card { padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; }
    .rccage-item-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); }
    .rccage-item-card b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 54px; height: 54px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-size: 1.4rem; }
    .rccage-item-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rccage-item-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rccage-benefits-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 24px; }
    .rccage-benefit { padding: 22px; border-radius: 26px; }
    .rccage-benefit h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rccage-benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rccage-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }
    .rccage-final-box { padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px); border-radius: 46px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)), url("https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-cage-2.png"); background-size: cover; background-position: center; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); overflow: hidden; }
    .rccage-final-box .rccage-pill,
    .rccage-final-box h2,
    .rccage-final-box p { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }
    .rccage-final-box p { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 1.08rem; }
    .rccage-final-box .rccage-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #2f4a2e; border: 2px solid #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22); text-shadow: none; }

    .rccage-related { padding: 74px 0; background: #fff9ef; opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; animation: none !important; }
    .rccage-related, .rccage-related * { opacity: 1 !important; filter: none !important; text-shadow: none !important; }
    .rccage-related .rccage-section-header { padding: 30px; border-radius: 34px; background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22); box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14); }
    .rccage-related .rccage-section-header .rccage-pill { color: #4e6b45 !important; }
    .rccage-related .rccage-section-header h2 { color: #243320 !important; opacity: 1 !important; text-shadow: none !important; }
    .rccage-related .rccage-section-header p { color: #332d26 !important; opacity: 1 !important; text-shadow: none !important; font-weight: 650; }
    .rccage-related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rccage-related-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr; gap: 15px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 24px; background: #ffffff !important; border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22); box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); transition: transform 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease; }
    .rccage-related-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); background: #fff; }
    .rccage-related-card img { width: 92px; height: 92px; max-width: 92px; max-height: 92px; border-radius: 20px; object-fit: cover; background: #f1eadf; }
    .rccage-related-card h3 { margin: 4px 0 6px; color: #243320 !important; line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 900; }
    .rccage-related-card p { margin: 0; color: #332d26 !important; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 650; }

    .rccage-disclaimer { padding: 0 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }
    .rccage-disclaimer p { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12); }

    .rccage-reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); animation: rccageFadeUp 0.9s ease forwards; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 12% cover 30%; }
    @keyframes rccageFadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.985); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
    @keyframes rccageFadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(26px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .rccage-page *, .rccage-page *::before, .rccage-page *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
      .rccage-reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 980px) {
      .rccage-page { left: 50%; width: 100vw; margin-top: -90px !important; transform: translateX(-50%); }
      .rccage-wrap, .rccage-narrow { width: min(100% - 28px, var(--rc-max)); }
      .rccage-hero-content, .rccage-article-layout, .rccage-image-split, .rccage-warning-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .rccage-sidebar { position: static; order: -1; }
      .rccage-quickbar-inner, .rccage-size-grid, .rccage-items-grid, .rccage-benefits-grid, .rccage-related-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .rccage-image-card { min-height: 420px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .rccage-page { left: 50%; width: 100vw; max-width: 100vw; margin-top: -90px !important; transform: translateX(-50%); overflow-x: hidden; }
      .rccage-wrap, .rccage-narrow { width: calc(100% - 24px); }
      .rccage-hero { padding: 0 0 28px; }
      .rccage-hero-title-overlay { left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 18px; padding: 18px; }
      .rccage-hero-title-overlay h1 { font-size: clamp(2.45rem, 13vw, 4rem); line-height: 0.92; }

          <details class="rccage-faq-item">
            <summary>Is a small rabbit cage enough?</summary>
            <p>No. Small cages and hutches are not enough as a rabbit’s main living space. Rabbits need a large enclosure or pen with constant access to exercise space.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rccage-faq-item">
            <summary>How tall should a rabbit enclosure be?</summary>
            <p>A rabbit enclosure should be tall enough for rabbits to stand upright and jump comfortably. A good minimum height is 1m, or about 3 ft 3 in.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rccage-faq-item">
            <summary>Do outdoor rabbits need a run?</summary>
            <p>Yes. Outdoor rabbits need a sheltered sleeping area and a secure run or enclosure with enough room to move, explore, forage and exercise safely.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

      <div class="rccage-wrap rccage-final-box">
        <span class="rccage-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>More space means a happier, healthier rabbit</h2>
        <p>
          Providing enough space is one of the most important parts of rabbit care. A rabbit’s enclosure should be large enough for them to hop, stretch and explore comfortably.
        </p>
        <p>
          While a good UK minimum is around 6 m², or about 64 sq ft, giving your rabbit as much safe space as possible will lead to a happier and healthier pet. Many owners find that large pens, indoor enclosures or free roam setups work much better than traditional cages.
        </p>
